adjudications.title: Candidate list renders no fit chip for a score-0 ('Poor fit') review; Overview/Plato tab and role_fit filter show it correctly
adjudications.rationale: Pre-existing + out-of-scope per the QA severity scale. The list chip code (JobApplicationListContainer.tsx and other roleFit consumers) has ZERO changes in the feature range f8815555a..HEAD (verified via git diff per-file). The identical absence was observed by agents 1 and 9 on the fixture-SEEDED review before any feature code path executed, and no SPEC requirement governs list chips. Likely falsy-zero guard on score in untouched list code. Kept prominent in QA-MED-FINDINGS for Jessica.
